authority: ROOT20min32ALLpeak2; once-only existing exact record, additional startup whitelist only
singleReadRule: Exactly one bounded stream read; validate SHA/size/fd identity BEFORE parsing the same in-memory bytes; no second hash-read/reopen, no locator inventory.

whitelist.applicationSpecific: Only bounded startup-diagnostic strings from asi; no arbitrary userdata; path redaction retained
whitelist.thread: Only report.faultingThread index; no triggered-thread fallback or other-thread scan
whitelist.frames: First up to8 of faulting thread: imageIndex,symbol,imageOffset,symbolLocation
whitelist.images: Only corresponding up to8 imageIndex/name/path/UUID/arch; no registers/base addresses/full image list
